book.steelstorm.manual.page1.body:
This outpost is yours. Take the starter weapons from the chest and practise on the dummies in the yard.

In Steelstorm, timing beats button mashing. Read on!
book.steelstorm.manual.page1.title: Welcome, Warrior
book.steelstorm.manual.page2.body:
The bar above your hunger is Stamina.

Dodging, heavy attacks and specials spend it. It refills once you stop using it for a moment, so pace yourself.
book.steelstorm.manual.page2.title: Stamina
book.steelstorm.manual.page3.body:
Press %1$s to dodge roll the way you are moving.

For a split second nothing can hurt you. Roll through the big, telegraphed attacks!
book.steelstorm.manual.page3.title: Dodge Roll
book.steelstorm.manual.page4.body:
Hold %4$s with a melee weapon to guard and take less damage.

Raise your guard just before a hit lands for a PERFECT PARRY: no damage, and your attacker staggers.
book.steelstorm.manual.page4.title: Guard & Parry
book.steelstorm.manual.page5.body:
Hold %5$s and press %3$s for a heavy attack: 1.5x damage and big knockback, for a little stamina.

Spears: hold %5$s and %4$s, then let go to throw.
book.steelstorm.manual.page5.title: Heavy Attacks
book.steelstorm.manual.page6.body:
Press %2$s to unleash your weapon's special move. Every weapon type has its own; check the tooltip.

Specials cost stamina and need time to recharge.
book.steelstorm.manual.page6.title: Special Moves
book.steelstorm.manual.page7.body:
Longsword: 3-hit combos
Greatsword: wide sweeps
Katana: bleeding crits
Daggers: backstabs
Spear: reach and throws
Warhammer: breaks armor
Scythe: life steal
Battleaxe: crushes guards
book.steelstorm.manual.page7.title: The Arsenal
book.steelstorm.manual.page8.body:
Stormsteel ore hides in the mountains. Its weapons crackle with lightning that leaps between foes.

Legendary weapons can't be crafted. Seek them in ruins, or take one from the Warlord.
book.steelstorm.manual.page8.title: Stormsteel & Legends
book.steelstorm.manual.page9.body:
Bandit camps dot the plains and forests. Iron Revenants walk at night.

In a ruined colosseum the Fallen Warlord waits. Bring diamond gear, and remember to dodge.
book.steelstorm.manual.page9.title: Dangers Abroad
message.steelstorm.outpost_welcome: A Warrior's Outpost stands beside you. Read the Combat Manual on the lectern before your first fight!
steelstorm.configuration.title: Steelstorm Arsenal Settings
tooltip.steelstorm.stormsteel: Stormsteel: hits may arc lightning to a nearby foe
weapon.steelstorm.dual_daggers.passive.d: Double damage when striking from behind.
weapon.steelstorm.greatsword.passive.des: Sweeping blows reach much further around the target.
weapon.steelstorm.longsword.passive.desc: Every 3rd hit in a row deals +30% damage.
weapon.steelstorm.spear.passive.desc: Strikes from 2 blocks further away and can be thrown.
